title: Spec snapshots
label: Spec snapshots
checked: Compiled specifications for every geom, feature, statistics helper, and gallery example, against committed snapshots.
description: scripts/evidence-tests.php runs the Pest suite and records each test that compares a specification with its snapshot. A changed specification fails until its snapshot is reviewed and updated.
inputs: Bundled mpg, mtcars, economics, and faithful datasets; the gallery catalog in examples/catalog.php.

comparison.applies_to: Specification JSON; inline data cut to three rows and a count

cases.name: ExamplesTest
cases.quantity: builds a valid spec for every gallery example

cases.quantity: compiles each feature to a valid Vega-Lite spec

cases.quantity: compiles each geom to a valid Vega-Lite spec
